entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned APP for the State alongwith learned counsel for the O.P. No. 02, Mrs. Y. Madhvi.
Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.87157 of 2019(5) dt.18-12-2023 2.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that whenever any dispute arises in between the husband and the wife the entire family members are implicated in a mechanical manner with general and omnibus allegations.

It is next submitted that petitioners are elder brother-in-law,
sister-in-law (gotni), elder brother-in-law, sister-in-law (gotni), grandmother- in-law and mother-in-law (chachiya saas) respectively of the O.P. No. 02.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that it absolutely does not stand to reason that as to why the petitioner No. 05 who is the grandmother-in-law of the O.P. No. 02 would have indulged in any act warranting her implication in the present criminal case, it is thus submitted that it amply demonstrates that the O.P. No. 02 having dispute with her husband in order to coerce him into submission implicated the entire family members with ornamental allegations.

Learned counsel for the petitioners further submits that O.P.
No. 02 who is a police constable posted with Begusarai police force has also performed her second marriage.
3. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the O.P. No. 02 seeks time for seeking further instructions.
4. Put up this case on 22.01.2024 5.
In the meantime, the order dated 20.05.2019 passed Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.87157 of 2019(5) dt.18-12-2023 by the learned CJM, Vaishali at Hajipur in Hajipur Town P.S. Case No. 348 of 2017, whereby cognizance of offence under Sections 498A, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code has been taken, shall remain stayed.
6. Learned counsel for the O.P. No. 02 is directed to file a counter-affidavit.
The counter-affidavit shall clearly record as to whether O.P. No. 02 has performed her second marriage or not.

(Satyavrat Verma, J) Adnan/-
